0022600109.text: The Dallas Mavericks, 0-1 and 11th in the West, host the San Antonio Spurs, also 0-1 and 10th in the West, with the Mavericks fifth in the Southwest and one game back. Dallas is missing Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Jett Howard (calf soreness), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Cooper Flagg is day-to-day with shoulder soreness and a game-time decision, averaging 32.0 points in 32.9 minutes this season. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after Dallas lost all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 139-120 in San Antonio on April 10, 2026.
